rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's seventeen builder trees go (corals and ficus along the back fences, canary date palms, a fan and a queen palm and corals 3-5.8 m from the house fronts, magnolias and jacarandas by the seating); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two or three houses: by the adirondack chairs and the grill, and in two back yards 12-17 m from the houses.

trees.why: the back yard with the adirondack chair (1.7 m off): a magnolia to sit under
the east back yard with the kettle grill (1.7 m off): a jacaranda over the cook
the south-west yard with the adirondack chair (1.5 m off): the same
the south-east lot corner, 17 m from the walls: a full coral tree
the north-east back yard, 12 m from the house: the yard's tree
